findings.statement: HF-075-F2b-VOCAB is NOT a class-identity or class-binding defect. F2b conclusion.conclusion_type = scc_c0_future_inextendibility is the canonical key of the pinned alias class whose alias list contains F0's strong_cosmic_censorship_C0; the owner checker applies that map to this exact field (check_taxonomy_consistency.py:25-27 at de356d999ea3) and the live cross-check is CONSISTENT. F1 and F2a match F0 the same way.

The genuine residual is a SPELLING-DIRECTION inconsistency inside the frozen F0 pair, not in F2b: the pinned policy says 'canonical token first; accepted aliases ... must never appear in a new canonical artifact', but the F0 canonical field_vocabulary.conclusion_type.allowed (research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml:149-152) enumerates only the alias forms strong_cosmic_censorship_C2/_C0, and the F0 class axes use those alias forms, while the F0 companion and all three schemas use the canonical keys. A literal consumer of F0's allowed list that does not consult VOCAB_ALIASES false-fails on every canonical-token schema.

Recommended disposition: withdraw HF-075-F2b-VOCAB as an F2b gate-blocker and record the F0 allowed-list direction as a frozen-F0 legacy residual for the gate owner; repair requires either a controller ruling that F0's allowed block is legacy alias-form, or a future authorized revision re-stamping one side. No in-place write to F0 is permissible (it voids G-F0, REC-35).
